posts.text: Interview: Move fast to secure Kyiv's future, Brussels economy chief tells Ukraine, EU countries EU countries and Ukraine need to respond quickly and decisively to a new financing proposal for Kyiv, the EU's Economy Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis told the Kyiv Independent in an interview on Nov. 18. Dombrovskis spoke just after the European Commission published a proposal to give Ukraine an additional 45 billion euro ($49 billion) loan in 2027, with additional measures to solicit third-country contributions, as first reported by the Kyiv Independent. "We need conceptual decisions rather soon, by December," Dombrovskis s aid. Photo: Wiktor Dabkowski / Bloomberg via Getty Images.
